_comment_format: Packer >=1.7 supports HCL2 (.pkr.hcl) and remains backward-compatible with this JSON format. JSON kept here because DigitalOcean's marketplace-partners examples still use it and the 1-Click validation tooling reads it directly. Convert to HCL when modernizing.
_comment_plugins: Packer 1.7+ requires explicit plugin install: `packer plugins install github.com/digitalocean/digitalocean`. The plugin pin is in versions/plugin-version.txt next to this file.
_comment_size: The BUILD droplet is intentionally larger than the cheapest production runtime: `go build` for the full Stave module needs more than 1 GB. The resulting snapshot still runs on s-1vcpu-1gb (the $6 production droplet) — DO snapshots can be applied to any size droplet that has at least the snapshot's disk size.

provisioners._comment: DigitalOcean ships marketplace-partners/scripts/img_check.sh — the canonical pre-submission validator. Pull it from GitHub directly during the build so we always validate against the current ruleset.
